decision: Rejected as rendering performance baselines: no egui_render GPU command buffers in the selected trace window. Hardened reruns fail explicitly with surface acquisition status Occluded.

validation.analysis: python3 -B scripts/summarize_metal_trace_test.py: 6 passed; positive event-controls smoke control contains 174 required egui_render buffers
validation.clippy: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features: passed with existing warnings
validation.architecture: Rust module structure, platform boundaries, and public-function documentation checks passed

methodology: Explicit execution-disabled native profile-frames, 30 warmup and 120 samples, 20-second minimum lifetime, 1440x900 logical points. Runner attaches Metal System Trace to its owned PID after 3 seconds, records 5 seconds, requires the time-limit marker while the app is alive, and successful trace save and app completion under a 45-second independent watchdog. No concurrent Cargo work during captures. Analysis window [1s,4s] trace-relative, selected before inspection. Whole command buffers crossing boundaries are excluded. This is an instrumentation/validity experiment, not paired timing or a speedup claim.
raw_retention: Retains complete CPU reports only as rejected evidence, process-filtered GPU summary distributions/counts, and source XML hashes. Raw .trace/XML files remain in the task's temporary directory and are not committed because Instruments includes unrelated system graphics/process metadata even with --attach. No unrelated process records are included here. Normalized per-buffer rows are not retained for these rejected captures.
preliminary_attempts: Small event-controls smoke trace completes and contains egui_render work; it is not used as a timing baseline.
Scale-100 screenshot capture and uninstrumented screenshot control both exceed 45 seconds; no report accepted.
A short no-screenshot scale run ends before attachment, motivating an explicit minimum lifetime.

The initial minimum-lifetime runner rejects an app exiting during trace serialization; the tested runner instead requires liveness through the recording time-limit marker. No timings from that rejected attempt are pooled.
